opening.argument: The video shows magnetic welding supports holding metal pieces at different angles and positioned against metal during welding. Those visible demonstrations establish a physical product being used for its stated purpose. The title identifies the product and names AliExpress and Amazon, while the description directs viewers to those marketplaces to buy it. That is an ordinary retail invitation tied to the demonstrated item. Nothing in the supplied material shows an unusual benefit promise or a participation scheme, and the evidence does not establish any purchase outcome.

citations.quote: New magnetic welding support magnet on Aliexpress and Amazon
